dimensions.question: Can a first-time reader explain in twenty seconds what this repo is for and what is real versus pending?
Does the README use this repository's concrete situations, mechanisms, and files rather than generic agent-platform language?
Is every material claim tied to an immutable source, and are open-pull-request increments labeled pending rather than shipped to main?
Can a reader recover the problem, promise, mechanism, and next action from headings, bold anchors, and link text alone?
Does the shipped asset carry one clear idea, and does the visual section state honestly that narrative rasters are not generated yet?
Does the README stay useful and readable when rendered narrow (phone) without wide code blocks dominating the first screen?

decision_rule: Accept only when claim_safety passes and no weighted dimension is below 3/5; human review may override a model score with a recorded reason.
